name: Ane x Boku
source:
An innocent boy Keita happens to live together with a female cousin Hiroko. Hiroko loses the last remains of her reason by his single utterance, "My penis grows bigger when I see you!"

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ031216?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
天真无邪的男孩庆太偶然与表弟弘子住在一起。弘子的一句话让她失去了最后的理智：“一看到你，我的阴茎就变大了！”

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ031216?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
